> 🤖 **AI-Assisted Issues:** Using AI to help draft your issue is perfectly fine! However, you **must** read through and verify that the information is accurate and relevant to this project. If an issue contains obvious AI hallucinations or unverified output, it will be rejected.
> 🚫 **No Bulk Creation:** Please do not bulk create issues. Submit one well-thought-out report at a time.

## Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## Environment
- **OS:** [e.g., Windows 11 23H2, Windows 10 22H2] *(Note: Only Windows 10 & 11 are supported)*
- **.NET Version:** [e.g., .NET 10.0]
- **App Version/Commit:** [e.g., v1.0.0 or commit hash]

## Screenshots / Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or copy/paste error logs to help explain your problem. (Please obscure any sensitive folder paths or passwords).

## Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here.
